About This Study

History of Music & Bands in the Commonwealth of Dominica, 1930s–2000s documents the creation, development, decline, and reinvention of Dominican band culture across generations.

The project gathers band histories, parish origins, musicians, instruments, venues, photographs, audio, field notes, and community testimony into a living digital archive.

Its public Band Map invites musicians, families, cultural workers, and diaspora stakeholders to help verify, correct, and expand the record.

Oral History
Interviews and memories from musicians, bandsmen, and cultural officers.
All Parishes
Band documentation by parish, village, and town.
Seven Decades
From colonial brass traditions to cadence, bouyon, and digital-era music.
